purpose: Give an aim involving an attainable state or prevention.
keywords: Verb dictionary / potential / negative form + ように
I spoke loudly so that I could be heard.
I wrote it in my planner so that I would not forget.
Please rest well so that you recover quickly.
Aim at an action, an ability, or avoiding an outcome
formation: Verb dictionary / potential / negative form + ように
restrictions: Often used where the goal is a state, ability, or event not directly controlled by a single action.
mistake: For a direct intentional action with the same agent, ために may be more natural.
